name: TestimonialCard - Quote Without An Event Photo
description: The testimonial as a full-width row rather than the boxed card it used to be, in its solo state: no event photo, so there is no second column and the quote runs the full width. The floor the card has to render at — every field except the quote and the name is optional, and the campaign's own Colorado quote ships with neither portrait nor a real event photo of its own.
